# Kick

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** Kick

## What it does

Kick is a one-shot utility that immediately disconnects you from the server you are currently playing on. Enabling the module triggers the disconnect instantly — it does not stay active. It will refuse to fire in singleplayer to prevent a potential game crash.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/kick). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
